title:
The async effect that reads the pending sensor settings changes from [Reliability.ReliabilityApplicationState](ReliabilityApplicationState) and
builds the necessary requests to update monitor settings and operating status
See {@link Sensor#updateMonitorSettings} and {@link Sensor#updateOperatingStatusSettings}.

If {@link Sensor#updateOperatingStatusSettings} is called, on success it will also show a success banner.

This epic will get input from the state of pendingSensorSettings from Reliability.ReliabilityApplicationState
name: UpdateSensorSettingsEpic
